title: Three futures for commune.md
question: Choose a direction to carry into the working site, or steer a fresh hand.

options.label: Routing Atlas
options.viewport: A monumental headline meets three linked sample notes on a navigable route.
options.risk: Routes must stay useful or the map becomes decoration.

raised.raise: One modular rhythm governs route maps and dense documentation.
Source and reading views show the same selected passage.
The current note remains unmistakable throughout the journey.
Compact metadata remains readable at high density.
Pending proof stays beside the associated capability.

options.label: Publishing Workshop
options.lineage: Independent literary publishing and type specimens
options.thesis: Your notes deserve a life beyond the folder.
options.viewport: An enormous literary headline opens into two linked pages and their markdown source.
options.risk: Editorial familiarity is deliberate and needs a working demo to earn its place.

options.label: Open Assembly
options.thesis: A personal wiki with a public voice.
options.viewport: A full-width type composition steps down into a sample note and its links.
options.risk: The loud opening must give way to a calm reading measure.
options.case: Strong independent-builder identity with a more demanding transition into product explanation.

options.label: Swiss Grid
options.thesis: A considered alternative to the selected route system.
options.viewport: Form adapted to linked notes and writing.
options.risk: The metaphor competes with the wiki task.
options.case: The atlas is stronger on audience identification and product clarity.
